name: TS391SNL
notes: Generated from this oven's measured rates, because the datasheet chart asks 1.40 C/s at 175-217 C where this oven has about 0.90, and 1.07 C/s into peak where run 0008 measured 0.63. A profile that cannot be followed still runs; it just misses its ramps and makes a joint nobody characterised. Peak is 249 C in the datasheet and 245 C here: 245 is 28 C above liquidus, inside the 20-40 C the alloy wants, and it leaves the ramp shortfall as the only unmet part of the recipe rather than adding a temperature nothing has demonstrated. Run 0008 reached 252.8 C, so 245 is inside the evidence. Every ramp asks 80% of measured capability so the controller has headroom instead of saturating. No hold at peak: at 245 C the climb and the fall earn 88 s above liquidus on their own, where at 235 C they earned 56 s and a 32 s dwell had to be added. The cooling tail is this oven's own door-shut curve, so the run completes unattended; opening the door beats it and is preferable. Time above liquidus is judged against 60-150 s, J-STD-020's window for the Pb-free classification profile.
reference: Chip Quik TS391SNL datasheet rev 1.2 (Sn96.5/Ag3.0/Cu0.5, mp 217-220 C); curve generated from data/oven-characterisation.json by tools/make_profile.py
